title: Wrong filter for multiple facet.
body:
Hello,
I have a case that I can't understand, for the example: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/examples/e-commerce/

In Material filter, I select Polypropylene option, have some products (e.g SPRUTT) matching the condition with the Green option in Color filter.
Then, I select both of Polypropylene and 100 % polyester options, the operator for the Material filter is **'or'** and I can find the SPRUTT product in the result, but the Green option in the Color filter will disappear.

Can anyone explain to me? Thanks!
